messages:
Maya R: quick async check-in — onboarding llama-3-smallq into the model catalog for Dedicated. Did initial smoke tests and small-batch evals; seeing an unexpected drop on the long-doc summarization suite (prompt_set: long-doc-summaries).
Chen Li: can you paste the eval numbers and the quant/serving config you used?
Maya R: sure — baseline(uncached): accuracy 0.87 -> smallq: 0.73, rouge-l 0.52 -> 0.39. Ran with quant_profile=`8bit-gptq-ppc`, kv_cache_warmup=false, seq_len=2048.
eval-bot: Automated regression alert — model=llama-3-smallq, suite=long-doc-summaries, delta=-0.14, severity=high, run_id=run_2026_03_16_12.
Evan P: hmm — kv-cache warmup off + aggressive quant can hit long-context summarization. Can you re-run with `kv_cache_warmup: true` and `max_batch_tokens: 1024`? I'll pick up PR #4138 for the quant config review today. @Maya R
Maya R: on it. Starting re-run now; also toggling `quant_profile: q4_0` for a comparison. will attach logs when done.
Disa: fyi prod routing still keeps the smallq variant behind canary; no public traffic. keep debugging there :+1:
Maya R: logs from the failed run:
```
2026-03-16T12:04:11Z warmup=false seq_len=2048 latency=1.8ms token/s=3500 error_rate=0.01
2026-03-16T12:04:32Z eval_summary delta=-0.14 rouge-l=0.39
```
Chen Li: please add the concrete failing examples to the prompt set `long-doc-summaries` as regression testcases — we should pin them in the CI harness so future onboards catch this.
Maya R: done, added 5 failing cases and opened PR #4140 (tests + brief repro). pinging @Evan for CR. ETA for re-run results ~20m.
Evan P: will try to review PR before EOD. If re-run improves, propose canary: 10% traffic for 24h with close evaluation on the same suite.
Maya R: no other blockers besides waiting on re-run and PR review. will follow up in this thread with updated numbers. thanks everyone!
